sections.section_title: SYSCFG Cortex-M55 P-AHB write posting control register (SYSCFG_CM55PAHBWPR)
sections.text_helper: Section 16.1.8 "SYSCFG Cortex-M55 P-AHB write posting control register (SYSCFG_CM55PAHBWPR)" in chapter 16 (System configuration controller (SYSCFG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 813.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x01C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reset by system reset.
Bits 31:1 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 0 PAHB_ERROR_ACK: Error capture in write posting buffer
0: Error capture
1: Clean error

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
